categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of recombinant proteins including target and factor proteins, recombinant antibodies, enzymes, and reagents. It also provides comprehensive application solutions for biopharmaceuticals, in vitro diagnostics, life science basic research, RNA vaccine drugs, and gene and cell therapy. Additionally, it offers contract research organization (CRO) services including customized protein and antibody expression, mRNA and RNA-related services, and technical package transfers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 7 comprehensive technology platforms and 23 core technologies covering molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, protein engineering, synthetic biology, and gene engineering. Key platforms include the Legotein® protein engineering platform, protein molecular evolution platform, antibody development platform, computer-aided protein expression design (CAPE) platform, and GMP-grade large-scale production and quality control platforms. Production involves high-density fermentation, stable cell line construction, protein purification, and strict quality control under ISO9001, ISO13485, and ISO45001 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global biopharmaceutical companies, vaccine developers, in vitro diagnostic reagent manufacturers, and life science research institutions. The company serves downstream sectors such as RNA vaccine drugs, antibody drugs, cell and gene therapy, molecular and immunodiagnostics, and synthetic biology. It supports over 3,000 customers worldwide, including those developing mRNA vaccines, antibody drugs, and diagnostic reagents.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Suzhou, China, with subsidiaries in Shanghai, Shandong, and the United States (New Jersey and California). It serves both domestic and international markets, with a growing overseas business segment. The company actively expands its global footprint through overseas marketing teams and international collaborations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the life sciences supply chain as a supplier of core raw materials and reagents, including recombinant proteins, antibodies, enzymes, and nucleic acid-related products. It provides essential inputs and technical solutions to downstream biopharmaceutical manufacturers, diagnostic reagent producers, and research institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in recombinant protein technologies, expansion of GMP-grade RNA-related products, development of multi-transmembrane protein antibodies, and integration of AI and synthetic biology. The company emphasizes full-process application solutions across biopharmaceuticals, diagnostics, and life science research. It invests heavily in R&D (over 39% of revenue) to develop new products, improve quality, and support emerging fields like mRNA vaccines, gene editing, and organoid research.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of recombinant proteins, antibodies, enzymes, and reagents. The company also earns income from CRO services, including customized protein expression, process development, and technology package transfers. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to large customers and supplemented by distributor channels for smaller or more diverse clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic recombinant protein market, especially in GMP-grade mRNA raw material enzymes where it ranks first with nearly 40% market share. It competes with international brands that historically dominated the market but benefits from strong technological capabilities, extensive product lines, and growing domestic demand for import substitution. The company is recognized as a top supplier in Asia-Pacific and among the top 10 local suppliers in innovative biopharmaceutical raw materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 127.6 million, a 16.7% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 54.4 million. Despite the decline, the company increased R&D investment to nearly 40% of revenue. Total assets were about RMB 2.22 billion with net assets of RMB 2.1 billion. The company serves nearly 3,000 customers globally and continues to expand its overseas business. The financial profile reflects industry cyclicality and strategic investments in innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core technological innovation in recombinant protein design, production, and quality control, offering high-purity, high-activity, and batch-consistent products. Its integrated full-process application solutions tailored to biopharmaceuticals, diagnostics, and life science research provide customers with reliable raw materials and technical support. The company’s proprietary platforms, such as Legotein® and CAPE, enable the development of novel proteins and antibodies, including challenging multi-transmembrane targets. Its GMP-grade production and quality systems support clinical and commercial applications, facilitating import substitution and global competitiveness.
